pages.title: Your first goal
pages.text: Make one bee produce a comb in the apiary, then process that comb in the centrifuge. FE is the power unit used by technology mods; side configuration decides which machine face accepts power or items and which face outputs products. Keep the first line small so problems are easy to find.

pages.title: Prepare the line
pages.text: You also need a centrifuge, an FE source, cable, a barrel or chest, one Productive Bees bee, and its matching flower or pollen. Hover an item and use JEI's recipe key to check how your modpack obtains it.

pages.title: Apiary recipe
pages.text: If the modpack replaces this recipe, use the recipe currently shown by JEI.

pages.title: Centrifuge recipe
pages.text: Build one normal machine of each type before upgrading to factories.

pages.title: Follow these steps
pages.text: 1. Power both machines and confirm their energy bars contain FE.$(br)2. Insert a bee or filled cage into the apiary.$(br)3. Put the JEI-listed flower or pollen in the Feeder.$(br)4. Wait for a comb, then move it into the centrifuge.$(br)5. Remove items and route honey or other fluids to separate fluid storage.

pages.title: Success
pages.text: The apiary progress bar moves and produces a typed comb; the centrifuge then runs and produces resources. Full outputs pause safely. Typed comb blocks can be processed directly, and their actual output multiplier follows the server setting.

pages.title: No progress?
pages.text: Check in this order: empty energy bar; redstone mode not set to Ignore; mismatched bee and flower; full item or fluid output; then an incorrect side setting. Change only one thing at a time so the cause stays obvious.
